authorization: The project owner explicitly requested resolution of the 23 listed code-scanning alerts.
operation: GitHub alert dismissals with individual or group-specific reasons and comments; no runtime source or scanning configuration changes.

groups.rationale: Synthetic session credentials, deterministic key-derivation compatibility inputs/output buffers and authenticated negative record fixtures are confined to integration tests.
Zero-initialized HKDF output arrays are fully overwritten by expand before being assigned to DRBG key state.
The zero-initialized next-key array receives ChaCha20 keystream before replacing the previous key.

The fast-key-erasure DRBG reserves the first 32 keystream bytes for the next private key, returns subsequent bytes and replaces the old key after each fill; the fixed nonce does not imply repeated use of a fixed key.
Password storage starts with len=0. Empty secrets are rejected and only the entered prefix is submitted.
LocateProtocol success and aligned(protocol), including a non-null check, are required before the reported GOP dereference.
Firmware::protocol requires HandleProtocol success and a non-null, aligned result before returning Ok. The caller skips failures; the Media pointer is checked separately.
QueryMode success, non-null/aligned information and sufficient size are required before the record is copied; FreePool occurs after the copy.
All three macro-mapped flows were inspected. The p and fs paths pass through the checked protocol wrapper; OpenVolume success and aligned(root) guard the root path.

limits: A dismissal is a triage disposition, not a source-code repair or complete security audit.
Pointer findings concern initial-null paths under the documented trusted live-firmware contract; null and alignment checks do not validate arbitrary hostile pointers.
No Rust unit test or native execution succeeded in this environment; Rust/Cargo, QEMU and OVMF are unavailable.
Two read-only AI investigations and integrator review are not an independent human audit.
